# Model Year 2023 Calibration

_Travel Model 1.7_ is a limited update to _Travel Model One_, including recalibration for a subset of the models. 

The calibration targets were derived primarily from the 2023 Bay Area Travel Study (BATS 2023) and the 2023 US Census.
